notes.title: Blue Crab Island DLC + FREE Patch For The Fisherman - Fishing Planet
notes.notes:
Today we're releasing the first DLC for The Fisherman - Fishing Planet, Blue Crab Island, an idyllic waterway that includes new Fish, new gear, and a new boat, which will be pretty important since a lot of angling on this waterway is done offshore. 

This will be released alongside some free updates for all owners of the game, so we're going to split the patch notes to highlight what's part of the Blue Crab Island DLC and what will be available for all owners of the game. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/958ce517e56bd61688aed537c28b500da317313e.png[/img]

[h1]Update Notes:[/h1]
[list][*] New Tackle Added 
[*] New spinning leaders, new lures and bassbaits, new baits all added
[*] Free Roaming
[*] Last position autosave added
[*] New collection missions
[*] Bite alarm volume has been reduced on rod stands
[*] Leaderboards have been redesigned 
[*] Game stability has been improved
[*] Better performance and server connection improvements
[*] Various graphical issues have been fixed
[*] Various physics improvements
[*] New location on White Moose[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35796865/19511e1d63b4cf3f590dba515158e63b60f44ed1.png[/img]

notes.title: DLC's issue Update
notes.notes:
Greetings Fisherman,

We wanted to let you know that we've identified the existing issues with [b]The Fisherman: Fishing Planet[/b] DLC's. We're working as fast as we can to solve them.

We're deeply sorry for the inconvenience this has on your experience.

Sincerely,

The Fishing Planet team.
